steps.content: //BG: Hospital room entrance

Outside the emergency room, harsh fluorescent lights sting your eyes. Their stark white glare mingles with the thick reek of disinfectant, pressing down on the waiting area until the air feels suffocating.

After what seems an eternity, the glaring red light—Emergency Treatment in Progress—suddenly blinks out. The door swings wide. The doctor pulls off his mask, exhaustion carved into every line of his face, and walks straight toward you.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Chief. Good news: the shackles you left inside her body did their job. They absorbed most of the corruption for her.
Your nerves stay stretched tight. You know, with sinking certainty, that a but is on its way.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: But she's been pushing her abilities past their limits for years. Her body gave out a long time ago. She was only managing through Eastian medicine. Most of her internal organs have deteriorated past the point of recovery. Honestly, it's remarkable she's made it this far.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: At this stage, life support is the only thing keeping her going. How long she holds on, whether she regains consciousness... that's out of our hands now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I understand. Thank you. For everything.
//Entering the hospital room
Inside the hospital room, machines keep their steady beep. Jichuan lies upon the bed, tethered by various medical lines. You take a quiet seat at her side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jichuan... just rest for now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry about a thing. Everyone's going to be here waiting. You just focus on holding on, alright?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've still got that plum branch you gave me. Soon as you wake up, we'll plant it together...
You know she probably cannot hear a word, so you do the only thing you can: you sit quietly at her bedside and keep a silent vigil.
Beep—Beep—Beep—
Night settles deeper, and the world narrows to the steady hum of the monitor and the whisper of Jichuan's breathing, so faint you strain to catch it.
Days of exhaustion finally overtake you. Resting against the edge of the bed, you let sleep pull you under.
//Black screen. Only the monitor's steady beeping remains.
Consciousness seeps back, and you find yourself in the interrogation room.
The metal table and chairs are familiar. The cold lighting is familiar. Only one thing is unexpected—Jichuan sits in the interrogation chair.
She wears her usual plain white dress, her face relaxed and serene, her gaze upon you perfectly calm.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Do not be alarmed. I sought you out of my own accord. That little chain you left within me is a curious thing. I thought if you could enter my consciousness, perhaps the current might flow both ways. I made the attempt, and here we are.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Though I confess, I did not imagine your dreamscape would take this form. What manner of place is this?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is an interrogation room in DisCity. I use it to look into Sinners' pasts, ask questions, and get answers.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I see. Then I am ready for that!
She even takes a moment to adjust her clothes with formality, accepting this space with surprising ease. A hint of excitement even flickers through her bearing.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Shall we begin the interrogation? What would you ask of me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're lying in a hospital bed right now, hooked up to more tubes than I can count. Why would I interrogate you like this? I just want you to wake up. Soon.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides, I've already filed my report on everything that happened at Northsnow Manor. There's nothing left to investigate. No loose ends.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: If you have no intention of questioning me, then allow me to question you instead!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Question me???

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Since you are here, you shall answer. First inquiry—
She gives you no time to react.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: As "Chief of the Bureau," what duties fill your days? What rhythm governs your time, and by what means do you keep counsel with the world beyond?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Detaining anomalies, managing case files, handling crises... Basically, if it involves the order and safety of Sinners, it lands on my desk.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My schedule's all over the place. Depends on whatever's happening that day. Overtime's a thing, vacation's a thing, though working through vacation is... also a thing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Most of my communication goes through a "terminal." I can get you one set up if you want. That way, you can skip the carrier pigeons and letters and reach me wherever you are.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Do you truly take me for some relic of a bygone age? I at least know the concept of electronic correspondence.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: It is only that the region I called home was plagued by frequent calamities, and thus lagged behind much of Eastia in such developments. And with all these years spent in seclusion at the manor, devoted to recovery, I never had cause to form connections elsewhere...
You prepare to offer words of comfort, but to your surprise, she shows no trace of sadness. A bright smile already graces her face as she moves on to her next question.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Second inquiry! Beyond your duties, have you pastimes to ease the hours? Do you share your leisure with friends?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I wouldn't say I have hobbies exactly, but I keep up with whatever's popular around DisCity. Games, movies, manga, stuff like that. Given the classified nature of my work, most of my friends are Bureau staff and Sinners.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Outside the Bureau... I've got a few connections. Met plenty of people while I was handling missions in Syndicate and Eastside.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Eastside, Syndicate... I recall now. My teacher always stressed the importance of knowing the wider world and its geography. Those are DisCity's eastern and western districts, are they not?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: What did you do there? Did you also don the guise of a wandering hero, investigating Mania from the shadows?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What I did in the eastern and western districts? That's... a long story. We can save it for another time—

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I wish to hear it.
She cuts you off mid-word. Her gaze settles on you, calm and impossibly steady.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I wish to hear it now.
The playfulness vanishes from Jichuan's tone entirely. In its place settles a quiet earnestness.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I want to know where you came from. Your past, your path, all that has shaped you... From Eastia to DisCity, we have walked together all this while, yet I have never had the chance to truly know you.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Would you... tell me now?
The word "now" falls from her lips with deliberate weight, and her smile holds something close to a plea. As though this moment is the only one you will ever have. Miss it, and there is no other.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't talk like that... You're going to wake up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not just going to share my life story with you now. I've still got so much work ahead, so many problems I'm going to need your help with. Oh, that reminds me!
You push yourself to rally, putting on the look of someone who has just landed on a brilliant idea.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know, so many Sinners are just like you. I met them while I was out on missions. And now they've joined the Bureau. They come with me on new investigations all the time!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So it'll be the same for you. I've been thinking... you'd be way better suited for strategy and coordination than frontline work. There are quite a few Sinners at the Bureau I think you'd really click with.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Might I meet them as well?
Jichuan appears swept up in your enthusiasm, pulled into the vision of the future you are sketching before her.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: What manner of people are these comrades of yours? I have little experience with Disians. I fear I may prove clumsy and bring you trouble instead.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You won't. You'll fit right in.
You start to think it over in earnest, summoning their faces to mind one after another.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A lot of them are like you, deep down, holding onto something they refuse to let go of, no matter how rough the road gets. Steady and determined.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then there are the ones who seem like they don't take anything seriously. Honestly, some of them are a real handful. But when it actually matters? More reliable than anyone. They pull through when you least expect it.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: That sounds rather familiar. Is that not Xiaofeng to the letter?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And there's more. Some carry a lot of secrets. They've got their own way of doing things, keep to themselves... like they're standing just at the edge of the world...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: They sound like the eccentric heroes from a storyteller's tale! They must be fascinating.

And so you keep going, telling her more and more. You tell her about past missions thick with danger, about how the West District has changed, about the troublesome Sinners at the Bureau who never give you a moment's peace, and about the many Eastians you have met along your path.
Watching her listen with such rapt attention, a memory surfaces: your first meeting. Back then, it was she who talked without end, introducing you to the martial world she knows inside and out.
You have no idea how long you speak, as time in dreams is always blurred. At last, just as you begin listing Summer's high-tech inventions for the third time, she smiles and says:

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Dawn is approaching. You will wake soon, I think.

The air between you grows suddenly heavy. Dawn breaks outside, and soon you must return to your work, to your friends. But Jichuan lies in that hospital bed, and who can say when she will have the strength, or the chance, to speak with you like this through the night again.
You try to hide it, but she catches the sorrow lingering in your eyes.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Do not grieve. I know my own body better than anyone. We have both done all that could be done.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This doesn't have to be goodbye. I've pulled you back from the edge so many times before. I know there'll be a next time, and another after that—

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Young hero... listen to me.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Life and death are currents beyond our command. Should I fall into slumber and never wake... do not let it burden your heart. And do not let despair take root because of me.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: That plum blossom I gave you... tend it with care. When it blooms, that shall be me, still beside you.
Gentle as her words are, each one finds its way to pierce your heart.
//Sound effect of the monitor
Beep... Beep...
The monitor's rhythmic beeping bleeds into your awareness, and with it, the edges of the dream begin to blur and distort.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, wait! I'm not done!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's right! I never showed you around DisCity. I promised I would.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: When was this? I do not recall.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When you were unconscious in the cave. That's right. DisCity's got this old street with Eastian charm, full of specialty shops tucked away everywhere. A bunch of people from the Bureau love going there. You could tell them what's authentic and what's fake.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I have journeyed all the way to DisCity... and you would take me to Eastian shops?
Beep—Beep—Beep—
The drone of the ventilator swallows your voices whole, and your words begin to scatter into incoherent rambling.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then we skip the shops. I'll pick a nice day and take all the Sinners from the Bureau out for team building. Do you know what team building is?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Going out to enjoy yourselves together?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes! Do you like hiking? There's this hill outside the city. From the top, you can see all of DisCity. Or maybe you'd want to try an amusement park? You've never left Eastia, so you've probably never been to one...
Beep—Beep—Beep—Beep—

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: All that you have named... I wish to see every one of them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then we'll see them all! We'll go to so many places together, help those who need it, stand up when something's wrong...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't you want to know how the manor is doing? Once you're better, we'll go back. Together.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: All right. We will go together.
The interrogation room starts to blur at the edges, and Jichuan blurs with it, her colors slowly draining away.
The world around you dissolves into obscurity. The ventilator's drone swallows every other sound. You watch Jichuan's lips form words, but none of them reach you.
Allow me to call you "young hero" one last time, just as I did when we first met.
Young hero, until we meet again.
//Black Screen
//Back to the hospital room
After that long night of conversation, Jichuan never visits your dreams again.

The days blur into one another. Your Eastian friends—the ones who help you search—keep sending messages, asking after her condition. You can only reply with the same brief words, repeated each time: "Still under observation."
Gradually, everyone at the Bureau grows used to it: the Eastian girl in the ICU, suspended in her unending sleep.

You have no choice but to plunge back into the relentless grind of work. The moments you can spare for her bedside dwindle and shrink. Only in the deepest hours of night do you slip away to her room, where she lies unchanged, still and silent, showing no sign of waking.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just how long are you gonna keep sleeping...
//Black Screen
//The Rust
This is the Rust's border. You have been fighting here for days, locked in a grueling, unrelenting battle.

Corruptors come in massive, endless waves, pouring through the blockade line without pause. The air is thick with smoke, choking and acrid. The battlefield roars with the sound of clashing steel and inhuman cries. Your unit fights on, mired in a desperate struggle that shows no sign of ending.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! The Sinners are en route with reinforcements. They'll be on site any moment!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Copy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All units, pull back and tighten the line! Hold position and wait for backup!

You sweep your gaze across the battlefield, swallowing the anxiety that burns in your chest as you coordinate your forces with every ounce of focus you have. Just then, a new frequency cuts into your combat terminal.
Southeast flank, the air stirs wrongly. Enemy forces may seek to encircle us. Dispatch a squad to intercept without delay.

The Corruptors at the front are all bluster, fierce but lacking substance. Send two defensive specialists to anchor the center and blunt their advance. As for your position, Chief... leave that to me.

In the very next breath, a figure in white tears across the battlefield like the arc of silver wings. Her blade moves with lethal grace, carving through the chaos, and wherever she passes, the Rust's Corruptors collapse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I told you to coordinate from the rear. What are you doing out here?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I insisted on coming. My pulse is steady today, and I have strength enough to spare. The physician rarely grants such leave, you know. If I do not move soon, my joints may well forget their purpose.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh? Well then, if I don't let you stretch your legs properly today, I'd be a pretty heartless Chief, wouldn't I?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Do not think to slacken your own efforts now! We made a promise, did we not? To face this world together, standing side by side. Hiding behind me would make a liar of you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's rich coming from you. You've been faking symptoms to trick me since the day you woke up. Don't you think you're in a pretty bad position to lecture anyone about honesty?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Then to be known alongside you as the <color=#fb9259>Gray-White Twin Deceivers</color>—why, I would count that the greatest fortune of my life.
Inside the porcelain vase on your office desk, the plum branch defies all reason and puts forth fresh, delicate buds.
